children: Duckworth, who was appointed to the board of Cloudcoco in June 2015, purchased the shares on Friday at an average price of 0.16p each, for a total value of £7,875.
Following the transaction, Duckworth holds a beneficial interest in 220.18m ordinary Cloudcoco shares, representing approximately 23.54% of the company's issued share capital.
As of 1515 BST, Cloudcoco shares were up 4.25% at 0.17p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
